_doc: Commands that must go through anti-stuck-flutter so sessions never fight over a device or kill each other's apps.

rules.message: Devices, emulators and heavy builds are shared between sessions through the anti-stuck-flutter device ledger. The command is `{{TOOL}}` (see the device-ledger skill). Run `{{TOOL}} status` first, then `{{TOOL}} run <device> [flutter run args]`, `{{TOOL}} exec <device> -- <cmd>`, `{{TOOL}} build -- <cmd>` or `{{TOOL}} emu <avd>`. If another session owns the device, `{{TOOL}} wait <device> "purpose"`; when done, `{{TOOL}} release <device>`. Never kill other sessions' apps or emulators (pkill etc.).
